newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: SOCCER-ZAMBIA RECALL BWALYA FOR CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ZAMBIA RECALL BWALYA FOR CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Veteran captain Kalusha Bwalya was awarded a reprieve by Zambian soccer officials on Tuesday when he was recalled for next month's World Cup qualifier against Zaire.
The 33-year-old attacking midfielder, who plays for Club America in Mexico, was dropped after Zambia's goalless home draw with South Africa in their last World Cup qualifier in January.
Bwalya, who has been the kingpin of the team for the last eight years, was overlooked for recent African Nations Cup qualifiers in Malawi and Mauritius.
But the former African Footballer of the Year is among five foreign-based players in a 19-man squad for the African zone group three match in Kinshasa.
